Absolutely awful and incompetent. Repeatedly dismissed, ignored and misdiagnosed my husband.

One GP even called us and asked whether we really needed the appointment as he wanted to go home for the day. When we got to the appointment he was immediately dismissive and argumentative. My husband asked for tablets which were working for him but was told that they would not work. He completely ignored and undermined my husband and argued with him. When he eventually listened he agreed that the tablets were the right ones. This appointment only lasted 5 minutes before we were dismissed. Absolutely awful.

The lack of care and urgency here meant my husband went untreated and undiagnosed for six months for what is now a life long debilitating condition. This is after 3 A&E visits which they were aware of.

Had to wait over a month for a sick note which was then texted over after multiple emails and phone calls chasing. Rude and incompetent receptionists who seem to hate their job and people. No compassion what so ever and they definitely need to review all of their staff as no one seems to care for the patients or about their job.

Stay
